title: Deathcord Music Disc
description: DeathCore Music Disc Mod is a minecraft mod that adds a Lot of music Disc To your world.
body:
#  **_Wellcome To Deathcord Music Disk Mod_**

This mod adds 40 brand‑new music discs to your Minecraft world.  
Players can discover these discs in several ways:

- Mob drops — certain creatures have a chance to drop them
- 
- Loot chests — found in structures across the world
- 
- Achievements — earn discs by completing custom advancement challenges
- 
- Creative Menu — all discs are available for testing or creative builds

Each disc features unique audio, giving players more variety for ambience, storytelling, or server events.
